725:t_117:1.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Reflect on your own evil deeds in the depths of darkness! You are guilty!」

725:t_118:0.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Enough with the 'darkness' and the 'blackness'! I'm not listening to that garbage!」

725:t_118:1.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Let's go! It ends here, and I'm done with your gloom!!」

725:t_119:0.en:
$$アマタ$$
「No matter how far you drag us into despair, I have my love with $$ミコノ$$!」

725:t_119:1.en:
$$アマタ$$
「As long as I have that, I'm not afraid of the dark! We'll fight beyond both life and death!!」

725:t_120:0.en:
$$シンジ$$
「I'm... moving forward... I want to move forward...!」

725:t_120:1.en:
$$シンジ$$
「No matter what you say, I... will fight!」

725:t_120:2.en:
$$カヲル$$
「(That's right, $$シンジ$$. You live by your own will)」

725:t_121:0.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Filthy creeps like you calling yourselves gods? Don't make me laugh!」

725:t_121:1.en:
$$ガロード$$
「I'll show you! The strength of humanity... the power to believe in our future!!」

725:t_122:0.en:
$$ロラン$$
「You took people's freedom and peace by force! How could you be gods!」

725:t_122:1.en:
$$ロラン$$
「You're the enemy of us all... of everything alive! I'll stop you here!!」

725:t_123:0.en:
$$アムロ$$
「If we lose to you, who've been swallowed by the dark, humanity can't move on!」

725:t_123:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
「We'll overcome the darkness! We're heading for the future!!」

725:t_124:0.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「We've kept fighting up to today by overcoming our pasts!」

725:t_124:1.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「We won't yield to the darkness! Because we know there's something beyond it!!」

725:t_125:0.en:
$$バナージ$$
「You're the ones who crush our possibilities... our future...!」

725:t_125:1.en:
$$バナージ$$
「We'll resist with everything we have! To protect what matters from your darkness!!」

725:t_126:0.en:
$$刹那$$
「Those who refuse to understand others and try to rule everything by force...!」

725:t_126:1.en:
$$刹那$$
「I will break through you! That is our fight!!」

725:t_127:0.en:
$$シン$$
「Now I understand everything! As long as there are people like you, war will never end!」

725:t_127:1.en:
$$シン$$
「I'm not falling into the darkness! What we want is a peaceful future!!」

725:t_128:0.en:
$$キラ$$
「Everyone has a sad past... But we won't be beaten by it...!」

725:t_128:1.en:
$$キラ$$
「People live on, overcoming their pasts and regrets! That strength won't lose to darkness!!」

725:t_129:0.en:
$$シャア$$
「The man I once was would have been swallowed by your darkness, and never climbed out of it...!」

725:t_129:1.en:
$$シャア$$
「But not now! I can see the path ahead... the future, for myself and for humanity!」

725:t_130:1.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Target confirmed. Attack objective: those who call themselves gods.」

725:t_131:0.en:
$$アルト$$
「My wings turn hope into power! Not that you could understand!」

725:t_131:1.en:
$$アルト$$
「Let's go! I'll fly, tearing through the darkness!!」

725:t_132:0.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Quit spouting garbage and listen to my song!!」

725:t_132:1.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Then all this talk of 'darkness' and 'blackness' will start to sound stupid!!」

725:t_133:0.en:
$$レド$$
「It's true, I still regret what I did even now...!」

725:t_133:1.en:
$$レド$$
「But that's no reason to stop walking! On Earth, I learned that there is a future... and what it means to live!!」

725:t_134:0.en:
$$宗介$$
「You thought you could break our hearts with baseless assumptions and cheap tricks, but you miscalculated badly!」

725:t_134:1.en:
$$宗介$$
「Humans may be weak creatures! But I'll teach you that you're even weaker and more foolish than we are!!」

725:t_135:0.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Before I'm crushed by the past, there's something I have to do...! That's why I'm alive!」

725:t_135:1.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「This life is for protecting the future... In other words, it's the power to strike you down!!」

725:t_136:0.en:
$$キリコ$$
「Despair... the darkness in the heart...」

725:t_136:1.en:
$$キリコ$$
「I live on, beyond it. That is my fight.」

725:t_137:0.en:
$$桂$$
「Sorry, Fake Gods Alliance! We faced the darkness inside ourselves a long time ago!」

725:t_137:1.en:
$$桂$$
「I don't need a bunch of dunderheads who can't grasp even that telling us humans what we are!!」

725:t_138:0.en:
$n
「So everyone overcame hope and despair, just like me.」

725:t_138:1.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Because that's what being human is.」

725:t_138:2.en:
$n
「All that's left is to smash those who deny the future we're heading for!」

725:t_138:3.en:
$n
「Get ready, evil gods! You're going to lose to humans!!」

725:t_139:0.en:
$$カミナ$$
「Show me, $$シモン$$! Show me your spirit!」

725:t_139:1.en:
$$シモン$$
「Yeah! I'm not going to screw up with Bro watching!」

725:t_139:2.en:
$$シモン$$
「Let's go! I'll combine Bro's fighting spirit with mine and create the biggest, strongest drill in the universe!!」
